tools.name: render
preview_template
tools.description:
Run a GenUI template and show it in the side pane, answering the problems found (validation, command errors, binding errors) or a short summary. Use it while writing a template file to check it.

A GenUI template is a JSON file: .claude/genui/<name>.json in the project, or ~/.claude/genui/<name>.json for the user. The user opens it with /genui <name>.
{
  "title": "…", "description"?: "…",
  "sources": { "<name>": { "argv": ["cmd", "arg"], "parse": "json"|"text"|"lines", "timeoutMs"?, "cwd"?, "allowFailure"?: true, "manual"?: true } },
  "refreshSeconds"?: 10,
  "tree": <node>
}
Commands run without a shell. Their output is data under the source's name. In any string of the tree, {{path | filter:arg}} binds it: a string that is one whole {{…}} keeps the value's type (numbers for progress), others interpolate.
Paths: r.items[0].name. Filters: length, first, last, count:k=v, where:k=v, where:k!=v, map:k, join:x, sort:k, take:n, split:x, trim, upper, default:x (	 
 s escapes).
Extra nodes: { "type": "each", "items": "{{…}}", "as": "x", "node": <node, or a table row array> }, { "type": "when", "test": "{{…}}", "node": <node>, "else"?: <node> }.
Extra button actions in templates: "refresh" (run every source again), "run" with "source" (run a "manual" source, then refresh). "prompt" may use {{source.path}} and {{form.<id>}}.
